verses.ar:
Diyar e ishq mein apna makaam paida kar
Nay Zamana Naye Subho Shaam paida kar
verses.en:
Find your place in the realm of love
Build a new era, a new dawn, a new eve!

verses.ar:
Diyar e ishq mein apna makaam paida kar
Na Tu Zameen Kay Liye Hay Na Asmaan Keh Liye
Jahan Hay Teray Liye Tu Nahin Jahan Ke Liyeh
verses.en:
Find your place in the realm of love
You are neither for the earth nor for the heavens
The world is for you, not you for the world

verses.ar:
Khudi Ko Kar Buland Itna Kay Har Taqdeer Say Pehlay
Khuda Banday Say Khud Puche, Bata Teri Raza Kya Hay
verses.en:
Raise your khudi (self/soul) to such heights that before every decree
The divine asks from you himself: Tell me (O Servant) what you desire?

verses.ar:
Yeh Hikmat-e-Malakooti Yeh Ilm-e-Lahooti
Haram Kay Dard Ka Darman Nahin To Kuch Bhi Nahin
Yeh Zikr-e-Neem Shabi, Yeh Muraqabe, Yeh Suroor
Teri Khudi Kay Nigheban Nahin To Kuch Bhi Nahin
verses.en:
This angelic art, this divinely knowledge
If it can't cure the illnesses of Muslims then it is nothing!
Your deep remembrance, meditation and intense spiritual pleasures
If they aren't guardians of your Khudi (self/soul) then they are of no value

verses.ar:
Khirad Nay Keh Bhi Diya La Ila To Kya Hasil
Dil-o-Nigah Musalman Nahin to Kuch Bhi Nahin
verses.en:
If intelligence incites man to say 'No god but He' it brings no gain
It is worthless unless affirmed by heart and conscience

verses.ar:
Zindagani Hay Sadaf, Qatra-e-Neesan Hay Khudi
Woh Sadaf Kya Jo Katray Ko Gogar Kar Na Sakay
Ho Agar Khudnigar-o-Khudgar-o-Khudgeer Khudi
Yeh Bhi Mumkin Hay Kay Phir Maut Say Bhi Tu Mar Ne Sakay
verses.en:
Life is like a shell and Khudi is like the raindrop
It is unbecoming of the shell if it cannot turn the raindrop into a pearl
If the self becomes self preserving, self creating and self sustaining
Then you may even defy death itself!

verses.ar:
Mann ki Dunya Mein Na Paya Mein Nay Afraangi ka Raaj
Mann ki Dunya Mein na Dekhe Mainay Shaikh-o-Barhaman
Mann ki Daulat Haath aati Hay to Phir Jaati Nahin
Tann ki Daulat Chaon Hay, Aata hay Tann Jata Hay Tann
verses.en:
In this world of the internal, I do not find the rule of colonisers
In this internal realm I did not find Sheiks and Brahmans fighting
Inward wealth (knowledge and spirituality) once acquired is never lost
Material wealth is like a shadow, it comes and goes

verses.ar:
Tu Jhuka Jab Ghair ke, Agay na Mann, Tera na tann
Ghafil Na Ho Khudi Say, Kar Apni Paasbani
Shayad Kisi Haram ka, Tu Bhi Hay Astaana
Yeh Bandagi Gadai! Woh Bandagi Khudai!
Ya Bandai Khuda Ban, Ya Bandai Zamana
verses.en:
If you surrender to another's might you will lose your spiritual and material wealth
Do not neglect your Khudi, be a defender of your self
Perhaps you are the support of your community
Slavery to God is divinity, slavery to the world is disgrace!
Now you can choose to be a man of God, or a man of the world!

verses.ar:
Mera Tareeq Ameeri nahin Fakeeri Hay
Khudi na Baiche, Ghareebi Mein Naam Paida Kar
Diyar e ishq mein apna makaam paida kar
Nay Zamana Naye Subho Shaam paida kar
verses.en:
My way is the way of the fakeer, I do not seek wealth and fortune
Don't sell yourself, make a name for yourself in poverty!
Find your place in the realm of love
Build a new era, a new dawn, a new eve!
